generation_metadata.agent_last_message:
## Summary

I have successfully built a complete RS274/NGC G-code simulator in Python that meets all your requirements. The implementation is production-ready and fully functional.

### ✅ Implementation Complete

**Location:** All source files are in `/workspace/output/`

**Modules Implemented:**
- `main.py` (6.4 KB) - Command-line interface with all required arguments
- `machine_state.py` (13 KB) - Complete machine state management
- `gcode_parser.py` (18 KB) - Full G-code parser with expression evaluation
- `executor.py` (48 KB) - Complete execution engine with all G/M codes
- `tracer.py` (19 KB) - Motion trace generation with time/distance/tolerance sampling

### 🎯 Key Features Delivered

**Complete G-code Support:**
- ✅ All motion commands: G0, G1, G2/G3 (arcs with I/J/K and R format)
- ✅ All 9 canned cycles: G81-G89 with proper sub-motion expansion
- ✅ All coordinate commands: G10, G28, G30, G53, G54-G59.3, G92-G92.3
- ✅ All modal groups and M-codes per specification
- ✅ Tool management: T selection, M6 change, G43/G49 length offset
- ✅ Coordinate transformations: machine coords, program coords, G92 offsets

**Trace Generation:**
- ✅ Time-step sampling (`--trace-time-step`)
- ✅ Distance-step sampling (`--trace-distance-step`)
- ✅ Position-tolerance sampling (`--trace-position-tolerance`)
- ✅ Proper segment indexing for canned cycle sub-motions
- ✅ Motion kind annotation (rapid/feed/probe)
- ✅ Initial state capture and delta encoding

**File Format Support:**
- ✅ Tool table files (RS274 format with `--tool-table`)
- ✅ Parameter files (input/output with `--parameter-input/--parameter-output`)
- ✅ Probe configuration (`--probe-box`, `--probe-tool`)
- ✅ Block delete mode (`--block-delete`)

### 🧪 Verified Functionality

All tests pass successfully:
- ✅ Basic linear motion (G0/G1)
- ✅ Canned cycles with proper segment expansion
- ✅ Arc motion with geometric interpolation  
- ✅ Tool changes and length offsets
- ✅ Trace generation with correct timing
- ✅ Parameter fil

comparison.note: Same node IDs can have corrected fixtures/assertions; transitions describe these rubric revisions, not repeated trials of an unchanged test suite.

provenance.availability: Portable score summary, not a complete regrade bundle. Raw regrade JSON, source/test snapshots and pytest reports were produced in a scratch working directory on the auditing workstation and are not committed.
